sourceContext.originPage: Admiral magazine article (10 ways to make your car last longer)

contentPattern.structure: small circular author avatar + author name + publish/updated/read-time line + row of social share icons

suitableFor: editorial article bylines (author avatar + name + date/read-time + share links) at the top of a story
compact one-line author attribution strips with an inline share-icon row
notSuitableFor: author identity pods with a full descriptive bio paragraph (use cards-bio)
team / people grids with role + socials (use cards-team)
article teaser grids with image + title + description (use cards-teaser)

usage.notes: NEW variant created for the Admiral magazine article byline strip: circular Gareth Herincx avatar, name, '23 March 2020 | Updated 1 December 2025 | 5 minute read', and Facebook/X/email/native-share icon links. Closest existing variant cards-team scored ~0.23 (people grid with role+socials, no date line, not a single-item horizontal strip) - below the 0.8 reuse threshold. Share links are static (href='#' / mailto:); forms are out of scope.
